# Project Reclaimer (Halo 3) dedicated server: Pterodactyl install script.
# Runs as root in the installer container with the server folder at
# /mnt/server. Downloads the Windows dedicated server build from GitHub
# releases, verifies it against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt and writes
# the start scripts. Reinstalling updates the executable and start scripts
# and keeps dedicated.toml, game/, content/, playlists/, bans.json and data/.
#
# The game files are NOT downloaded: Halo 3's files come from your own copy
# of Halo: The Master Chief Collection and are uploaded into game/.
set -euo pipefail

REPO=ProjectReclaimer/project-reclaimer-releases
SERVER_DIR=${INSTALL_DIR:-/mnt/server}

say() { printf '[install] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() {
    say "Error: $*"
    exit 1
}

if ! command -v curl > /dev/null || ! command -v sha256sum > /dev/null; then
    apt-get update -qq
    apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates coreutils
fi

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR"
cd "$SERVER_DIR"

version=${RECLAIMER_VERSION:-latest}
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    release=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest") ||
        fail "could not reach the GitHub API for $REPO"
    tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$release" | grep -m1 '"tag_name"' |
        sed -E 's/.*"tag_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/' || true)
    [ -n "$tag" ] || fail "could not find the latest release of $REPO"
else
    tag="v${version#v}"
fi
say "Project Reclaimer $tag"

base="https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$tag"
sums=$(curl -fsSL "$base/SHA256SUMS.txt") || fail "release $tag not found (no $base/SHA256SUMS.txt)"

# The dedicated-only build exists from 0.8.14; older releases have only the
# full client, which runs dedicated servers too.
asset=""
for candidate in "project-reclaimer-dedicated-$tag.exe" "project-reclaimer-$tag.exe"; do
    if printf '%s\n' "$sums" | grep -q "[ *]$candidate\$"; then
        asset=$candidate
        break
    fi
done
[ -n "$asset" ] || fail "release $tag has no Windows server executable"
expected=$(printf '%s\n' "$sums" | grep "[ *]$asset\$" | head -n 1 | cut -d ' ' -f 1)

say "Downloading $asset..."
curl -fL --retry 3 -o project-reclaimer.exe.new "$base/$asset"
actual=$(sha256sum project-reclaimer.exe.new | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
    rm -f project-reclaimer.exe.new
    fail "checksum mismatch for $asset (expected $expected, got $actual)"
fi
mv -f project-reclaimer.exe.new project-reclaimer.exe
printf '%s\n' "$tag" > .reclaimer-version
say "Verified SHA-256 $actual"

#!/bin/bash
# Project Reclaimer (Halo 3) dedicated server: Pterodactyl start script.
# Written into the server folder by the egg's installer; reinstalling the
# server rewrites it. Mirrors the official Docker image's entrypoint:
#   1. make the Wine prefix (first start only)
#   2. make the server folder with `dedicated init` (first start only)
#   3. point the first [[server]] at this server's Pterodactyl allocation
#   4. wait until `dedicated check` passes, then run the servers
set -euo pipefail
SERVER_DIR=${HOME:-/home/container}
cd "$SERVER_DIR"

EXE="$SERVER_DIR/project-reclaimer.exe"
CHECK_INTERVAL=15

say() { printf '[egg] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() {
    say "Error: $*"
    exit 1
}

[ -f "$EXE" ] || fail "$EXE is missing. Reinstall the server from the panel's Settings tab."

# The yolk's entrypoint starts Xvfb on :0 when XVFB=1.
if [ "${XVFB:-1}" != 1 ]; then
    unset DISPLAY
fi

# 1. Wine prefix. No audio driver: the servers play no sound, and without
# a sound card Wine's ALSA driver fills the log with errors.
if [ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/system.reg" ]; then
    say "Creating the Wine prefix in $WINEPREFIX (first start only)..."
    WINEARCH=win64 wineboot --init > .wine-init.log 2>&1 || {
        cat .wine-init.log
        fail "wineboot failed"
    }
    wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\Drivers' /v Audio /t REG_SZ /f >> .wine-init.log 2>&1 || true
    wineserver --wait
fi

# 2. Server folder: a commented dedicated.toml, playlists/, content/,
# bans.json and data/. Never touches an existing dedicated.toml.
if [ ! -f dedicated.toml ]; then
    say "No dedicated.toml yet: creating the server folder..."
    wine "$EXE" dedicated init .
    say "Created dedicated.toml. Edit it in the File Manager to name the server and pick maps or a playlist."
fi

# 3. The first [[server]] block's port follows the primary allocation, so
# players reach it through the port Pterodactyl forwards. Other [[server]]
# blocks are left alone: give each its own allocation and port by hand.
if [ "${EGG_SYNC_PORT:-1}" = 1 ] && [ -n "${SERVER_PORT:-}" ]; then
    awk -v port="$SERVER_PORT" '
        function finish() {
            if (in_first && !done) { print "port = " port; done = 1 }
            in_first = 0
        }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[\[[[:space:]]*server[[:space:]]*\]\]/ {
            finish()
            blocks++
            print
            if (blocks == 1) in_first = 1
            next
        }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[/ { finish(); print; next }
        in_first && /^[[:space:]]*port[[:space:]]*=/ {
            if (!done) { print "port = " port; done = 1 }
            next
        }
        { print }
        END { finish() }
    ' dedicated.toml > .dedicated.toml.egg
    if cmp -s dedicated.toml .dedicated.toml.egg; then
        rm -f .dedicated.toml.egg
    else
        cat .dedicated.toml.egg > dedicated.toml
        rm -f .dedicated.toml.egg
        say "Set the first [[server]]'s port in dedicated.toml to $SERVER_PORT (this server's allocation)."
    fi
fi

# 4. Wait for the game files and settings to check out. Upload Halo 3's
# files into game/ over SFTP while this waits; no restart needed.
last=""
while ! report=$(wine "$EXE" dedicated check 2>&1); do
    if [ "$report" != "$last" ]; then
        printf '%s\n\n' "$report"
        say "Waiting for 'dedicated check' to pass. Fix the above in the File Manager or over SFTP."
        say "Halo 3's files go in game/ (game/halo3/halo3.dll, game/halo3/maps/shared.map, the maps you host, campaign.map, 040_voi.map; 050_floodvoi.map for Flood Infection)."
        say "Checking again every ${CHECK_INTERVAL} seconds."
        last=$report
    fi
    sleep "$CHECK_INTERVAL"
done
printf '%s\n' "$report"

args=(dedicated)
if [ "${VERBOSE:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    args+=(--verbose)
fi

# 5. Panel console: each line typed there goes to the first server's
# remote console (Source RCON at 127.0.0.1:<its game port>), so it works
# with RCON closed to the internet. Needs an RCON password.

# The RCON Password variable, else the first [[server]]'s rcon_password,
# else [rcon] password from dedicated.toml.
rcon_password() {
    if [ -n "${RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_RCON_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_RCON_PASSWORD"
        return
    fi
    awk '
        function value() { sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*"/, ""); sub(/".*$/, ""); return $0 }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[\[[[:space:]]*server[[:space:]]*\]\]/ { servers++; in_rcon = 0; in_first = (servers == 1); next }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[/ { in_first = 0; in_rcon = ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*\[[[:space:]]*rcon[[:space:]]*\][[:space:]]*(#.*)?$/); next }
        in_first && /^[[:space:]]*rcon_password[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"/ { own = value() }
        in_rcon && /^[[:space:]]*password[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"/ { shared = value() }
        END { if (own != "") print own; else if (shared != "") print shared }
    ' dedicated.toml
}

# The first [[server]]'s name, so `dedicated rcon` reaches that server
# when dedicated.toml lists several.
first_server_name() {
    awk '
        /^[[:space:]]*\[\[[[:space:]]*server[[:space:]]*\]\]/ { if (seen++) exit; in_first = 1; next }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[/ { if (in_first) exit; next }
        in_first && /^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"/ {
            sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*"/, "")
            sub(/".*$/, "")
            print
            exit
        }
    ' dedicated.toml
}

# Lines go through the server's own `dedicated rcon`, not gorcon's rcon-cli:
# rcon-cli reads only the first reply packet, which cut long replies such as
# `players` short. It also gets the console spot kept for this machine.
console_bridge() {
    local line name
    local -a opts
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        line=${line%$'\r'}
        [ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ] || continue
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*[Nn][Ee][Xx][Tt][Vv][Oo][Tt][Ee]([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then
            if [ -f next-vote.toml ]; then
                printf '%s\n' "$line" >> .next-vote-request
            else
                say "The next-game vote needs next-vote.toml beside dedicated.toml (see the egg's README)."
            fi
            continue
        fi
        if [ -z "$(rcon_password)" ]; then
            say "Console commands need an RCON password: set the RCON Password variable (8-128 characters) and restart."
            continue
        fi
        opts=()
        name=$(first_server_name)
        if [ -n "$name" ]; then
            opts=(--server "$name")
        fi
        # xargs splits the line into words and keeps "quoted names" whole.
        printf '%s\n' "$line" | xargs wine "$EXE" dedicated rcon "${opts[@]}" 2>&1 ||
            say "RCON command failed. Is the server still starting? Quote names with spaces in matching quotes."
    done
}

# The egg's "server started" marker: keep in sync with config.startup.done.
say "dedicated check passed: starting Project Reclaimer"
if [ "${CONSOLE_RCON:-1}" = 1 ] && [ -n "${SERVER_PORT:-}" ]; then
    say "Console commands are sent over RCON, e.g. status, players, kick <player> [reason], map <name>."
    # A background job's stdin is /dev/null unless redirected explicitly.
    exec 3<&0
    console_bridge <&3 3<&- &
fi
# 6. Reserved slots for whitelisted players (reclaimer-reserved-slots.py),
# kept over RCON beside the first server. Settings come from
# reserved-slots.toml, and Reserved Slots variables override it.
if { [ -z "${RESERVED_SLOTS:-}" ] && [ -f reserved-slots.toml ]; } ||
    [ "${RESERVED_SLOTS:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2> /dev/null; then
    if ! command -v python3 > /dev/null; then
        say "Reserved slots need python3, which this image doesn't have."
    elif [ ! -f reclaimer-reserved-slots.py ]; then
        say "reclaimer-reserved-slots.py is missing: reinstall the server to get it."
    else
        python3 reclaimer-reserved-slots.py "$EXE" < /dev/null 3<&- &
    fi
fi
# 7. Next-game vote (reclaimer-next-vote.py): an admin starts it with
# !nextvote in chat or nextvote in the panel console, players pick from
# next-vote.toml, and the winner is queued with RCON nextmap.
if [ -f next-vote.toml ]; then
    if ! command -v python3 > /dev/null; then
        say "The next-game vote needs python3, which this image doesn't have."
    elif [ ! -f reclaimer-next-vote.py ]; then
        say "reclaimer-next-vote.py is missing: reinstall the server to get it."
    else
        python3 reclaimer-next-vote.py "$EXE" < /dev/null 3<&- &
    fi
fi
# The server keeps the foreground (and PID for Ctrl+C) as before; the
# console bridge, not the server, reads the panel's input.
exec wine "$EXE" "${args[@]}" < /dev/null 3<&-
START_SH
chmod +x reclaimer-start.sh

cat > reclaimer-reserved-slots.py << 'RESERVED_SLOTS_PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reserved slots for whitelisted players, run beside the first [[server]].

Written into the server folder by the egg's installer as
reclaimer-reserved-slots.py; start.sh runs it when Reserved Slots is above 0
or reserved-slots.toml exists. It talks to the server only through
`dedicated rcon`, like the panel console.

With max_players = M and R reserved slots, players who aren't whitelisted
may hold at most M - R slots (split-screen guests count):
  - Once they hold all of them, the server gets a join password (the
    reserved password), so the Server Browser shows it as PRIVATE and other
    players are asked for it instead of being kicked. Whitelisted players
    know it. The password comes off again when a public slot frees up.
  - A player who isn't whitelisted and still gets into a reserved slot
    (a leaked password, or two joins at once) is kicked: newest first.
  - With bumping on, a whitelisted player refused from a full server makes
    room: one player who isn't whitelisted is kicked, chosen by the bump
    order, and the server stays locked briefly so the whitelisted player
    can join again into that slot.
Admins (dedicated.toml and the Admins variable) are always whitelisted.

Like Project Reclaimer 0.9.18 servers, it takes up saved edits to
dedicated.toml and reserved-slots.toml without a restart: a file that
doesn't check out leaves the previous settings in place, and slots = 0
opens the server and pauses until slots go up again.

Settings come from reserved-slots.toml beside dedicated.toml (the Server
Manager writes it), and an egg variable that isn't empty overrides its key,
like the RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_* variables do for dedicated.toml:
  slots       RESERVED_SLOTS       number of reserved slots; 0 turns this off
  whitelist   RESERVED_WHITELIST   player IDs (the variable adds to the file's)
  password    RESERVED_PASSWORD    the join password whitelisted players use
  bump        RESERVED_BUMP        true or false
  bump_order  RESERVED_BUMP_ORDER  rules, first rule first:
                lowest_score        lowest score in the game being played
                least_session_time  shortest time on the server this visit
                least_total_time    least time on this server, all visits
"""

import json
import os
import queue
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    import tomllib
except ImportError:  # Python before 3.11
    tomllib = None

ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b[0-9a-fA-F]{64}\b")
POLL_SECONDS = 10           # re-check even without events
RETRY_SECONDS = 15          # wait while RCON doesn't answer
HOLD_SECONDS = 60           # keep the server locked after a bump
BUMP_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 30  # one bump per whitelisted player per this long
SAVE_SECONDS = 60
SETTINGS_FILE = Path("reserved-slots.toml")
PLAYTIME_FILE = Path("data") / "reserved-slots-playtime.json"
DEFAULT_BUMP_ORDER = ["lowest_score", "least_session_time"]
BUMP_RULES = ("lowest_score", "least_session_time", "least_total_time")
EVENT_WORDS = ("join", "leave", "left", "disconnect", "kick", "ban", "refus")

KICK_RESERVED = "That slot is reserved. Join again when the server has a public slot free."
KICK_BUMP = "Removed to make room for a reserved-slot player."


def say(message):
    print(f"[slots] {message}", flush=True)


def fail(message):
    say(f"Error: {message}. Reserved slots are off until this is fixed and the server restarts.")
    sys.exit(1)


class SettingsError(Exception):
    """dedicated.toml or reserved-slots.toml doesn't work for reserved slots."""


def problem(message):
    raise SettingsError(message)


def split_list(text):
    return [item.strip() for item in re.split(r"[,\s]+", text or "") if item.strip()]


# ---- settings ---------------------------------------------------------------

class Settings:
    def __init__(self):
        if tomllib is None:
            fail("needs Python 3.11 or later")
        toml = self.load(Path("dedicated.toml"))
        own = self.load(SETTINGS_FILE) if SETTINGS_FILE.exists() else {}
        env = lambda name: os.environ.get(name, "").strip()

        try:
            self.reserved = int(env("RESERVED_SLOTS") or own.get("slots", 0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            problem("Reserved Slots (slots) must be a number")
        if self.reserved <= 0:
            return

        servers = toml.get("server") or [{}]
        server = servers[0]
        defaults = toml.get("defaults", {})
        self.server_name = server.get("name", "")

        rcon_password = env("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_RCON_PASSWORD") or server.get("rcon_password") or toml.get("rcon", {}).get("password")
        if not rcon_password:
            problem("reserved slots need an RCON password: set the RCON Password variable or [rcon] password")

        # A [[server]] value beats the Max Players variable, which beats [defaults].
        if "max_players" in server:
            self.max_players = int(server["max_players"])
        elif env("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_MAX_PLAYERS"):
            self.max_players = int(env("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_MAX_PLAYERS"))
        else:
            self.max_players = int(defaults.get("max_players", 16))

        if "password" in server:
            own_password = server["password"]
        else:
            own_password = env("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_PASSWORD") or defaults.get("password", "")
        if own_password:
            problem("the server already has a join password; reserved slots need it empty, since they set one only while the server is full")

        self.public = self.max_players - self.reserved
        if self.public < 1:
            problem(f"{self.reserved} reserved slots leave no public slots with max_players = {self.max_players}")

        self.password = env("RESERVED_PASSWORD") or str(own.get("password", ""))
        if not self.password or re.search(r"\s", self.password) or len(self.password) > 128:
            problem("set the reserved password: up to 128 characters, no spaces")

        bump = env("RESERVED_BUMP").lower() or own.get("bump", False)
        self.bump = bump is True or bump == "true"
        order = env("RESERVED_BUMP_ORDER")
        self.bump_order = split_list(order) if order else list(own.get("bump_order") or DEFAULT_BUMP_ORDER)
        unknown = [str(rule) for rule in self.bump_order if rule not in BUMP_RULES]
        if unknown:
            problem(f"unknown bump order rule {', '.join(unknown)} (use {', '.join(BUMP_RULES)})")

        admins = list(toml.get("admins", [])) + list(server.get("admins", []))
        admins += split_list(env("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_ADMINS"))
        listed = [str(i) for i in own.get("whitelist", [])] + split_list(env("RESERVED_WHITELIST"))
        for entry in listed:
            if not ID_RE.fullmatch(entry):
                say(f"Ignoring '{entry}' in the whitelist: a player ID is 64 hexadecimal characters.")
        self.whitelist = {i.lower() for i in admins + listed if ID_RE.fullmatch(i)}
        if not self.whitelist:
            say("Warning: nobody is whitelisted. Add player IDs to the whitelist or to Admins.")

    @staticmethod
    def load(path):
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                return tomllib.load(f)
        except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as e:
            problem(f"could not read {path} ({e})")


# ---- RCON -------------------------------------------------------------------

class Rcon:
    """Runs the server's own `dedicated rcon` client, one process per command."""

    def __init__(self, exe, server_name):
        self.base = ["wine", exe, "dedicated", "rcon"]
        if server_name:
            self.base += ["--server", server_name]

    def command(self, *args, as_json=False):
        cmd = self.base + (["--json"] if as_json else []) + list(args)
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=30)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError((result.stderr or result.stdout).strip() or f"exit code {result.returncode}")
        return result.stdout

    def players(self):
        out = self.command("players", as_json=True)
        try:
            return parse_players(json.loads(out))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            # Take the last line that parses, should a notice come first.
            for line in reversed(out.splitlines()):
                try:
                    return parse_players(json.loads(line))
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    continue
        raise RuntimeError("the players reply wasn't JSON")

    def watch(self):
        cmd = self.base + ["--json", "--watch"]
        return subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1)


class Player:
    def __init__(self, raw, pid):
        self.id = pid
        self.name = str(raw.get("name") or pid[:8])
        self.admin = bool(raw.get("admin") or raw.get("is_admin"))
        score = raw.get("score")
        self.score = score if isinstance(score, (int, float)) else 0
        guests = raw.get("guest_players")
        # Split-screen players count toward max_players.
        self.slots = 1 + (len(guests) if isinstance(guests, list) else 0)


def player_id(node):
    for key in ("player_id", "id", "xuid"):
        value = node.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, str) and ID_RE.fullmatch(value):
            return value.lower()
    return None


def parse_players(reply):
    """Every object in the reply that carries a player ID, outside guest lists."""
    found = []

    def walk(node):
        if isinstance(node, dict):
            pid = player_id(node)
            if pid:
                found.append(Player(node, pid))
                return
            for key, value in node.items():
                if key != "guest_players":
                    walk(value)
        elif isinstance(node, list):
            for value in node:
                walk(value)

    walk(reply)
    return found


# ---- the slot keeper --------------------------------------------------------

class SlotKeeper:
    def __init__(self, settings, rcon):
        self.s = settings
        self.rcon = rcon
        self.locked = None          # unknown until set
        self.active = True          # False while slots = 0
        self.watch_proc = None      # the `dedicated rcon --watch` follow_events reads
        self.hold_until = 0.0
        self.joined = {}            # player ID -> when first seen this visit
        self.arrival = {}           # player ID -> order first seen, newest highest
        self.arrivals = 0
        self.last_bump = {}         # whitelisted ID -> when it last caused a bump
        self.totals = self.load_totals()
        self.last_tick = time.monotonic()
        self.last_save = self.last_tick

    def stop_watch(self):
        """End the event stream, so follow_events starts one with the current RCON."""
        proc = self.watch_proc
        if proc and proc.poll() is None:
            proc.terminate()

    # Playtime ---------------------------------------------------------------

    def load_totals(self):
        try:
            return {k: float(v) for k, v in json.loads(PLAYTIME_FILE.read_text()).items()}
        except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
            return {}

    def save_totals(self):
        try:
            PLAYTIME_FILE.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            tmp = PLAYTIME_FILE.with_suffix(".tmp")
            tmp.write_text(json.dumps({k: round(v) for k, v in self.totals.items()}))
            tmp.replace(PLAYTIME_FILE)
        except OSError as e:
            say(f"Could not save playtime ({e}).")

    def track(self, players):
        now = time.monotonic()
        elapsed = now - self.last_tick
        self.last_tick = now
        present = {p.id for p in players}
        for pid in list(self.joined):
            if pid not in present:
                del self.joined[pid]
                del self.arrival[pid]
        for p in players:
            if p.id in self.joined:
                self.totals[p.id] = self.totals.get(p.id, 0.0) + elapsed
            else:
                self.joined[p.id] = now
                self.arrivals += 1
                self.arrival[p.id] = self.arrivals
        if now - self.last_save >= SAVE_SECONDS:
            self.save_totals()
            self.last_save = now

    # Decisions --------------------------------------------------------------

    def whitelisted(self, p):
        return p.admin or p.id in self.s.whitelist

    def rank_key(self, p):
        now = time.monotonic()
        key = []
        for rule in self.s.bump_order:
            if rule == "lowest_score":
                key.append(p.score)
            elif rule == "least_session_time":
                key.append(now - self.joined.get(p.id, now))
            elif rule == "least_total_time":
                key.append(self.totals.get(p.id, 0.0))
        # Ties go to whoever joined last.
        key.append(-self.arrival.get(p.id, 0))
        return key

    def kick(self, p, reason):
        try:
            self.rcon.command("kick", p.id, *reason.split())
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - keep running whatever RCON says
            say(f"Could not kick {p.name}: {e}")
            return False
        return True

    def set_lock(self, locked):
        if locked == self.locked:
            return
        try:
            self.rcon.command("password", self.s.password if locked else "")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            say(f"Could not {'set' if locked else 'clear'} the join password: {e}")
            self.locked = None
            return
        if locked:
            say("Public slots full: the server now needs the reserved password to join.")
        elif self.locked is not None:
            say("A public slot is free: the server is open again.")
        self.locked = locked

    def check(self):
        players = self.rcon.players()
        self.track(players)
        others = [p for p in players if not self.whitelisted(p)]
        used = sum(p.slots for p in others)

        # Players who aren't whitelisted in reserved slots: newest out first.
        while used > self.s.public and others:
            newest = max(others, key=lambda p: self.arrival.get(p.id, 0))
            if self.kick(newest, KICK_RESERVED):
                say(f"Kicked {newest.name}: they took a reserved slot.")
            others.remove(newest)
            used -= newest.slots

        self.set_lock(used >= self.s.public or time.monotonic() < self.hold_until)
        return players

    def refused(self, pid):
        """A whitelisted player was turned away; make room if the server is full."""
        players = self.rcon.players()
        used = sum(p.slots for p in players)
        if used < self.s.max_players:
            return  # not full, so refused for another reason
        if not self.s.bump:
            say("A whitelisted player was refused from the full server. Bumping is off.")
            return
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self.last_bump.get(pid, -BUMP_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) < BUMP_COOLDOWN_SECONDS:
            return
        self.track(players)
        others = [p for p in players if not self.whitelisted(p)]
        if not others:
            say("A whitelisted player was refused, but everyone on the server is whitelisted.")
            return
        target = min(others, key=self.rank_key)
        if self.kick(target, KICK_BUMP):
            self.last_bump[pid] = now
            self.hold_until = now + HOLD_SECONDS
            self.set_lock(True)
            say(f"Bumped {target.name} for a whitelisted player, who can join again now.")


# ---- main loop --------------------------------------------------------------

def follow_events(keeper, inbox):
    """Feeds the main loop from `dedicated rcon --watch`, restarting it if it ends."""
    while True:
        try:
            proc = keeper.watch_proc = keeper.rcon.watch()
            for line in proc.stdout:
                text = line.strip()
                if not text:
                    continue
                kind = text.lower()
                try:
                    event = json.loads(text)
                    if isinstance(event, dict):
                        # Lines read {"type": "event", "event": "join", ...}: the kind is "event".
                        kind = str(event.get("event") or event.get("kind") or event.get("type") or kind).lower()
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass
                if not any(word in kind for word in EVENT_WORDS):
                    continue
                if "refus" in kind:
                    for pid in ID_RE.findall(text):
                        if pid.lower() in keeper.s.whitelist:
                            inbox.put(("refused", pid.lower()))
                inbox.put(("changed", None))
            proc.wait()
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            say(f"Event stream stopped ({e}); checking every {POLL_SECONDS} seconds meanwhile.")
        time.sleep(RETRY_SECONDS)


def config_stamp():
    """When dedicated.toml and reserved-slots.toml last changed."""
    stamp = []
    for path in (Path("dedicated.toml"), SETTINGS_FILE):
        try:
            stamp.append(path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
        except OSError:
            stamp.append(0)
    return tuple(stamp)


def load_settings(first):
    """New settings, or None (saying why) when the files don't work for reserved slots."""
    try:
        return Settings()
    except SettingsError as e:
        keep = "Reserved slots are off" if first else "Keeping the previous settings"
        say(f"Error: {e}. {keep} until dedicated.toml or reserved-slots.toml is fixed.")
        return None


def apply_settings(fresh, keeper, exe, inbox):
    """Start the keeper, or switch it to new settings. Returns it (None while off from the start)."""
    if fresh.reserved <= 0:
        if keeper is not None and keeper.active:
            keeper.active = False
            keeper.set_lock(False)
        say("Reserved slots are off (slots = 0).")
        return keeper
    if keeper is None:
        keeper = SlotKeeper(fresh, Rcon(exe, fresh.server_name))
        threading.Thread(target=follow_events, args=(keeper, inbox), daemon=True).start()
    else:
        old = keeper.s
        keeper.s = fresh
        keeper.active = True
        if fresh.server_name != old.server_name:
            # Another first server: talk to it from now on.
            keeper.rcon = Rcon(exe, fresh.server_name)
            keeper.locked = None
            keeper.stop_watch()
        elif keeper.locked and fresh.password != old.password:
            keeper.locked = None  # set the new password at the next check
    say(f"{fresh.reserved} of {fresh.max_players} slots reserved for "
        f"{len(fresh.whitelist)} whitelisted player(s); bumping "
        f"{'on (' + ', '.join(fresh.bump_order) + ')' if fresh.bump else 'off'}.")
    return keeper


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        fail("usage: reclaimer-reserved-slots.py <path to project-reclaimer.exe>")
    exe = sys.argv[1]
    inbox = queue.Queue()
    keeper = None
    stamp = None

    down = False
    while True:
        # Saved edits apply without a restart, as they do on the server.
        now_stamp = config_stamp()
        if now_stamp != stamp:
            first = stamp is None
            stamp = now_stamp
            fresh = load_settings(first)
            if fresh is not None:
                if not first:
                    say("Settings changed.")
                keeper = apply_settings(fresh, keeper, exe, inbox)
        if keeper is None or not keeper.active:
            time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
            continue
        try:
            refused = set()
            try:
                kind, pid = inbox.get(timeout=POLL_SECONDS)
                if kind == "refused":
                    refused.add(pid)
                while True:  # handle a burst of events at once
                    kind, pid = inbox.get_nowait()
                    if kind == "refused":
                        refused.add(pid)
            except queue.Empty:
                pass
            for pid in refused:
                keeper.refused(pid)
            keeper.check()
            if down:
                say("Server answering again.")
                down = False
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            if not down:
                say(f"Waiting for the server's remote console ({e}).")
                down = True
            # A restarted server has its own password back: set it again.
            keeper.locked = None
            time.sleep(RETRY_SECONDS)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Next-game vote for the first [[server]]: an admin starts it, players pick.

Written into the server folder by the egg's installer as
reclaimer-next-vote.py; start.sh runs it when next-vote.toml exists. It
talks to the server only through `dedicated rcon`, like the panel console.

  1. An admin types !nextvote in game chat, or nextvote in the panel console.
  2. The server lists games from next-vote.toml in chat, numbered. Players
     answer with the number (!2 or 2); a player's last answer counts.
  3. When the time is up, the game with the most votes is queued with RCON
     `nextmap`: the game being played finishes, then the winner plays
     instead of the playlist's ballot, once. With no votes nothing changes.

Admin commands, in game chat (with !) or in the panel console (without):
  nextvote          start a vote
  nextvote end      close the vote now and queue the leader
  nextvote cancel   close the vote without changing anything
  nextvote list     show the games next-vote.toml offers

next-vote.toml is read each time a vote starts, so edits need no restart:

  vote_seconds = 60       # 15 to 300
  choices_per_vote = 4    # games drawn at random from the list; 0 = all (at most 9)

  [[choice]]
  name = "Snipers on Valhalla"            # optional: what players read
  map = "Valhalla"                        # as a playlist entry names it
  game = "Game Modes/snipers.json"        # a mode, bundled mode or saved game type
"""

import json
import os
import queue
import random
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    import tomllib
except ImportError:  # Python before 3.11
    tomllib = None

SETTINGS_FILE = Path("next-vote.toml")
# start.sh writes panel console lines starting with "nextvote" here.
REQUEST_FILE = Path(".next-vote-request")
RETRY_SECONDS = 15
MAX_CHOICES = 9
VOTE_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:!vote\s+|!)?([1-9])\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)
COMMAND_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*!nextvote\b\s*(.*)$", re.IGNORECASE)


def say(message):
    print(f"[vote] {message}", flush=True)


def fail(message):
    say(f"Error: {message}.")
    sys.exit(1)


class SettingsError(Exception):
    """next-vote.toml can't be used."""


# ---- settings ---------------------------------------------------------------

def load_settings():
    if not SETTINGS_FILE.exists():
        raise SettingsError(f"{SETTINGS_FILE} is missing")
    try:
        with open(SETTINGS_FILE, "rb") as f:
            raw = tomllib.load(f)
    except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as e:
        raise SettingsError(f"could not read {SETTINGS_FILE} ({e})") from e
    try:
        seconds = int(raw.get("vote_seconds", 60))
        per_vote = int(raw.get("choices_per_vote", 4))
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as e:
        raise SettingsError("vote_seconds and choices_per_vote must be numbers") from e
    if not 15 <= seconds <= 300:
        raise SettingsError("vote_seconds must be 15 to 300")
    if not 0 <= per_vote <= MAX_CHOICES:
        raise SettingsError(f"choices_per_vote must be 0 to {MAX_CHOICES}")
    choices = []
    for i, c in enumerate(raw.get("choice") or [], 1):
        if not isinstance(c, dict) or not str(c.get("map", "")).strip() or not str(c.get("game", "")).strip():
            raise SettingsError(f"choice {i} needs a map and a game")
        name = str(c.get("name") or f"{c['game']} on {c['map']}").strip()
        choices.append({"name": name, "map": str(c["map"]).strip(), "game": str(c["game"]).strip()})
    if len(choices) < 2:
        raise SettingsError("list at least two [[choice]] games")
    return {"seconds": seconds, "per_vote": per_vote or MAX_CHOICES, "choices": choices}


def first_server():
    """(name, has an RCON password) of the first [[server]] in dedicated.toml."""
    try:
        with open("dedicated.toml", "rb") as f:
            toml = tomllib.load(f)
    except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as e:
        raise SettingsError(f"could not read dedicated.toml ({e})") from e
    server = (toml.get("server") or [{}])[0]
    password = (os.environ.get("RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_RCON_PASSWORD", "").strip()
                or server.get("rcon_password") or toml.get("rcon", {}).get("password"))
    return server.get("name", ""), bool(password)


# ---- RCON -------------------------------------------------------------------

class Rcon:
    """Runs the server's own `dedicated rcon` client, one process per command."""

    def __init__(self, exe, server_name):
        # Wine on the egg's Linux image; straight on Windows, for testing.
        self.base = ([] if os.name == "nt" else ["wine"]) + [exe, "dedicated", "rcon"]
        if server_name:
            self.base += ["--server", server_name]

    def run(self, *args, as_json=False):
        cmd = self.base + (["--json"] if as_json else []) + list(args)
        return subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

    def command(self, *args, as_json=False):
        result = self.run(*args, as_json=as_json)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(clean_error(result.stderr or result.stdout) or f"exit code {result.returncode}")
        return result.stdout

    def chat(self, text):
        try:
            self.command("say", text)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - a lost line shouldn't stop the vote
            say(f"Could not post to chat ({e}).")

    def tell(self, player_id, text):
        try:
            self.command("tell", player_id, text)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - they may have left
            pass

    def admins(self):
        data = json.loads(self.command("players", as_json=True) or "{}")
        players = data.get("players", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
        return {str(p.get("id", "")).lower() for p in players or [] if p.get("admin")}

    def watch(self):
        return subprocess.Popen(self.base + ["--json", "--watch"], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)


def clean_error(text):
    return re.sub(r"^Error:\s*", "", (text or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if (text or "").strip() else "")


# ---- the vote ---------------------------------------------------------------

class Vote:
    def __init__(self, settings):
        pool = list(settings["choices"])
        random.shuffle(pool)
        self.choices = pool[:settings["per_vote"]]
        self.seconds = settings["seconds"]
        self.ends = time.monotonic() + self.seconds
        self.ballots = {}       # player ID -> choice index
        self.reminded = set()

    def cast(self, player_id, number):
        if 1 <= number <= len(self.choices):
            self.ballots[player_id] = number - 1
            return True
        return False

    def tally(self):
        counts = [0] * len(self.choices)
        for i in self.ballots.values():
            counts[i] += 1
        return counts

    def standings(self):
        counts = self.tally()
        order = sorted(range(len(counts)), key=lambda i: -counts[i])
        return ", ".join(f"{self.choices[i]['name']} {counts[i]}" for i in order if counts[i]) or "no votes yet"

    def winner(self):
        """(choice, votes), ties drawn at random; None without votes."""
        counts = self.tally()
        top = max(counts)
        if top == 0:
            return None
        return random.choice([self.choices[i] for i, n in enumerate(counts) if n == top]), top


class Runner:
    def __init__(self, exe):
        self.exe = exe
        self.vote = None
        self.rcon = None
        self.server = None

    def connect(self):
        """Follows dedicated.toml's first server (renaming it needs no restart)."""
        name, has_password = first_server()
        if not has_password:
            raise SettingsError("the vote needs an RCON password: set the RCON Password variable or [rcon] password")
        if self.rcon is None or name != self.server:
            self.rcon, self.server = Rcon(self.exe, name), name
        return self.rcon

    # Commands, from an admin in chat (by = player ID) or the panel console (by = None).
    def handle(self, args, by=None):
        words = args.split()
        sub = words[0].lower() if words else "start"
        reply = (lambda text: self.rcon.tell(by, text)) if by else say
        try:
            rcon = self.connect()
        except SettingsError as e:
            say(f"Error: {e}.")
            return
        if sub == "start":
            if self.vote:
                reply("A next-game vote is already open.")
                return
            try:
                settings = load_settings()
            except SettingsError as e:
                say(f"Error: {e}.")
                reply(f"Can't start the vote: {e}.")
                return
            self.vote = Vote(settings)
            say(f"Vote started{' by an admin in game' if by else ''}.")
            rcon.chat(f"Vote for the next game! Type the number in chat ({self.vote.seconds} s):")
            for n, c in enumerate(self.vote.choices, 1):
                rcon.chat(f"  !{n}  {c['name']}")
        elif sub in ("end", "stop"):
            if not self.vote:
                reply("No next-game vote is open.")
                return
            self.finish()
        elif sub == "cancel":
            if not self.vote:
                reply("No next-game vote is open.")
                return
            self.vote = None
            rcon.chat("The next-game vote was cancelled.")
            say("Vote cancelled.")
        elif sub == "list":
            try:
                settings = load_settings()
            except SettingsError as e:
                reply(f"{e}.")
                return
            reply(f"{len(settings['choices'])} games, {settings['per_vote']} per vote, {settings['seconds']} s: "
                  + "; ".join(c["name"] for c in settings["choices"]))
        else:
            reply("Use nextvote, nextvote end, nextvote cancel or nextvote list.")

    def chat_line(self, event):
        text = str(event.get("text", ""))
        player_id = str(event.get("id", "")).lower()
        if not player_id or event.get("channel") == "server":
            return
        command = COMMAND_RE.match(text)
        if command:
            try:
                admin = player_id in self.connect().admins()
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                say(f"Could not check whether {event.get('name', 'a player')} is an admin ({e}).")
                return
            if admin:
                self.handle(command.group(1), by=player_id)
            else:
                self.rcon.tell(player_id, "Only admins can start a next-game vote.")
            return
        number = VOTE_RE.match(text)
        if self.vote and number and self.vote.cast(player_id, int(number.group(1))):
            pass  # counted; standings go out with the reminders

    def tick(self):
        if not self.vote:
            return
        left = self.vote.ends - time.monotonic()
        if left <= 0:
            self.finish()
            return
        for mark in (30, 10):
            if left <= mark < self.vote.seconds and mark not in self.vote.reminded:
                self.vote.reminded.add(mark)
                self.rcon.chat(f"{mark} s left to vote for the next game: {self.vote.standings()}.")

    def finish(self):
        vote, self.vote = self.vote, None
        result = vote.winner()
        if not result:
            self.rcon.chat("No votes for the next game: the server picks it as usual.")
            say("Vote closed without votes.")
            return
        choice, votes = result
        try:
            self.rcon.command("nextmap", choice["map"], choice["game"])
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.rcon.chat(f"{choice['name']} won, but the server can't queue it.")
            say(f"Could not queue {choice['name']} (nextmap {choice['map']} / {choice['game']}): {e}")
            return
        self.rcon.chat(f"Next game: {choice['name']} ({votes} vote{'s' if votes != 1 else ''}). It starts after this game.")
        say(f"Queued {choice['name']} with {votes} vote(s). Totals: {vote.standings()}.")


# ---- inputs -----------------------------------------------------------------

def follow_chat(runner, inbox):
    """Feeds chat lines from `dedicated rcon --watch` to the main loop, restarting it if it ends."""
    down = False
    while True:
        try:
            proc = runner.connect().watch()
            for line in proc.stdout:
                try:
                    event = json.loads(line)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    continue
                if isinstance(event, dict) and event.get("event") == "chat":
                    if down:
                        say("Server answering again.")
                        down = False
                    inbox.put(("chat", event))
            proc.wait()
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            if not down:
                say(f"Waiting for the server's remote console ({e}).")
                down = True
        time.sleep(RETRY_SECONDS)


def console_requests(inbox):
    """Panel console lines starting with nextvote, which start.sh leaves in REQUEST_FILE."""
    while True:
        try:
            lines = REQUEST_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            REQUEST_FILE.unlink()
        except OSError:
            lines = []
        for line in lines:
            inbox.put(("console", re.sub(r"^\s*nextvote\b\s*", "", line, flags=re.IGNORECASE)))
        time.sleep(1)


def main():
    if tomllib is None:
        fail("needs Python 3.11 or later")
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        fail("usage: reclaimer-next-vote.py <path to project-reclaimer.exe>")
    runner = Runner(sys.argv[1])
    try:
        n = len(load_settings()["choices"])
        say(f"Next-game vote ready with {n} games: an admin types !nextvote in chat, or nextvote in this console.")
    except SettingsError as e:
        say(f"Error: {e}. Fix next-vote.toml; it's read again when a vote starts.")
    REQUEST_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    inbox = queue.Queue()
    threading.Thread(target=follow_chat, args=(runner, inbox), daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=console_requests, args=(inbox,), daemon=True).start()
    while True:
        try:
            kind, data = inbox.get(timeout=1)
            if kind == "chat":
                runner.chat_line(data)
            else:
                runner.handle(data)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - keep the vote helper running
            say(f"Error: {e}")
        try:
            runner.tick()
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            say(f"Error: {e}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
NEXT_VOTE_PY

variables.name: Project Reclaimer Version
variables.description: Release to install, such as 0.9.5, or latest. Applied when the server is (re)installed. Every player needs the same version as the server.

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: Host name shown in the Server Browser. Empty keeps host_name from dedicated.toml.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (none by default).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Default player limit, 1-127, split-screen players included (a campaign co-op server takes 16 at most). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (16 by default).

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: Player IDs with kick and ban rights, separated by commas. Added to the admins in dedicated.toml. A player's ID is in the server log when they join.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Set one (8-128 characters) to turn on the remote console, which the panel console uses to send commands. Empty leaves it off.

variables.name: RCON Address
variables.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps the remote console inside the container (the panel console still works). 0.0.0.0 also opens it to the internet on TCP at this server's port, for the desktop RCON app.

variables.name: Console Commands Via RCON
variables.description: 1 sends each line typed in the panel console to the first server's remote console. Needs an RCON password.

variables.name: Public Address
variables.description: IPv4 address or DNS name players connect to. Empty detects it (api.ipify.org). Set it when the node's outgoing address differs from the allocation's.

variables.name: Anti-Cheat
variables.description: enforce, detect (log only) or off. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (enforce).

variables.name: Block VPNs
variables.description: true or false. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Hidden
variables.description: true keeps the server out of the Server Browser (players use Direct Connect). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: Min Players
variables.description: Wait in the lobby until this many players are in: no playlist vote or automatic start before that. 1 up to Max Players. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (1 by default).

variables.name: Welcome Message
variables.description: A chat line every player reads as they join, such as your rules or Discord. {name} is the player's name, {server} the server's. Needs text chat. For several lines use a list in dedicated.toml. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting.

variables.name: Friendly Fire
variables.description: false stops players hurting teammates and campaign co-op partners in every game. true follows each game type's own rules. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Team Changing
variables.description: How far players may change teams themselves: balanced (only to a team with fewer players), game_type (as each game type allows) or off. Admins can always move players. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (balanced).

variables.name: Voice Chat
variables.description: false turns all voice chat off. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Global Voice
variables.description: Global voice (V key). false with Team Voice false leaves only proximity chat. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Team Voice
variables.description: Team voice (B key). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Proximity Voice
variables.description: Proximity voice (N key). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Text Chat
variables.description: true or false. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Chat Log
variables.description: Keep each server's text chat in data/<server>/chat, a file per day. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Player Votes
variables.description: Let players vote to kick a player, end the round or end the game. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Max Ping
variables.description: Turn away players whose ping is over this many milliseconds as they join (checked only at the join), up to 1000. 0 takes everyone. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (0).

variables.name: Load Timeout
variables.description: Seconds one player's game may hold up the next game while it loads, before that player is removed so the others can play. 0 waits as long as it takes. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (30).

variables.name: Share Mods
variables.description: true lets players who lack a mod in content/Mods download it from the server. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: Share Rate
variables.description: Upload limit for shared mods per server, in Mbit/s. 0 is no limit. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (20).

variables.name: Trust Player Games
variables.description: Campaign co-op: when every player's game goes out of step with the server's, take one player's game instead of making everyone load the server's. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: VPN Lists
variables.description: More lists of networks Block VPNs refuses (https:// addresses or files, one IP or range per line), separated by commas. Added to dedicated.toml's [vpn] lists; include default to keep the default lists beside your own.

variables.name: Stats Server
variables.description: Where finished games are reported for players' ranks: empty uses dedicated.toml (the project's public service by default), off reports nowhere, or your own service's https:// address.

variables.name: Character Mods
variables.description: Character mods (in content/Mods) whose characters every server's multiplayer games add, by the names Customize shows, separated by commas: Armor Pack,Sci-Fi Heroes. Added to dedicated.toml's. Needs all 27 multiplayer maps in game/.

variables.name: Require Character Mods
variables.description: true: players must accept the character mods to join. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: No Vanilla Characters
variables.description: true: every player plays one of the character mods' characters, never Halo 3's own. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: Auto Reload
variables.description: Apply saved edits to dedicated.toml, playlists and content while the servers run (0.9.18 and later), without dropping players. false waits for the reload command in the console. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: true installs each new Project Reclaimer release and restarts. Otherwise update by reinstalling with version latest.

variables.name: Local Master Server
variables.description: Run this machine's own discovery master. Not needed to be listed: servers always report to the two public masters. If true, add an allocation for Master Port.

variables.name: Master Port
variables.description: TCP port of the local master server, when it is on. Must be one of this server's allocations.

variables.name: Servers To Run
variables.description: Which [[server]] blocks of dedicated.toml to run: positions, names or ports, such as 1 or 1,2. Each server needs its own UDP allocation.

variables.name: Sync Port
variables.description: 1 sets the first [[server]]'s port in dedicated.toml to this server's primary allocation on every start. 0 leaves dedicated.toml alone.

variables.name: Verbose Log
variables.description: 1 prints everything the servers log, not just joins, leaves, kicks, bans and errors.

variables.name: Reserved Slots
variables.description: Slots only whitelisted players may take, out of the first server's max_players. While the public slots are full the server needs the reserved password to join. 0 turns this off; empty uses reserved-slots.toml (off without one). Needs an RCON password.

variables.name: Reserved Whitelist
variables.description: Player IDs that may use reserved slots, separated by commas. Added to the whitelist in reserved-slots.toml. Admins always may.

variables.name: Reserved Password
variables.description: Join password set while the public slots are full; give it to whitelisted players. No spaces. Empty uses reserved-slots.toml.

variables.name: Reserved Bumping
variables.description: true kicks a player who isn't whitelisted when a whitelisted player is refused from the full server, so they can join. Empty uses reserved-slots.toml (off without one).

variables.name: Bump Order
variables.description: Who gets bumped first: lowest_score, least_session_time (this visit), least_total_time (all visits), separated by commas. Ties go to the newest player. Empty uses reserved-slots.toml, else lowest_score,least_session_time.

variables.name: Virtual Display
variables.description: Runs Wine on a virtual display (Xvfb), as the official Docker image does.
